summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for Google Sign-In configuration card and API contract. Targeted regression suite passed, including public-safe field exposure, admin-only controls, manager denial, save/status behavior, and state restoration.
action_items: No blocking issues found for this scope.
Keep Google OAuth customer sign-in/callback work tracked separately (configuration-only scope is validated).
critical_code_review_comments: Public /api/site-settings correctly returns only google_signin_enabled + google_client_id and never returns secret-related fields.
Admin-only access control is enforced via get_current_admin; manager role is correctly forbidden (403).
PATCH rejects empty/unknown-only payloads with 400 and does not overwrite stored secret when empty string is sent.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a temporary manager account during manager-forbidden authz test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Sign-In configuration scope is validated end-to-end and site settings were restored after UI test. Temporary auth selector instability was due auto-open configure state; resolved in final flow. MOCKED: Google OAuth customer callback/sign-in flow remains out of scope and not implemented.
rca of the issue: No functional defects found in the requested Google Sign-In configuration scope. Earlier UI automation misses were test-script assumptions (configure panel auto-opens when client ID is empty), not product bugs.
